title: UK regulator threatens universities with sanctions unless they adopt AI-proof exam formats
summary_raw: England's higher education regulator, the Office for Students, says AI has made it "nearly impossible" to fairly assess student coursework. To save the credibility of degrees, universities now have to return to traditional exams or face sanctions. title: Nvidia's model GR00T 2 watches humans on video, then imagines itself as the robot
summary_raw: Nvidia's new AI model GR00T 2 is designed to teach robots new tasks without laborious teleoperation. Instead, the system transfers human hand movements from videos to robotic arms, trained on about 400,000 hours of video footage. Success rates still vary widely, though, ranging from 10 to 80 percent depending on the task.
